BL-1270 — Per-provider API plan usage discovery — research and feasibility matrix
What it solves: Discovery slices are cheap and unblock implementation work. The feasibility
matrix is the deliverable — a document under docs/reference/ that future
slices consume. This slice has no code, no tests (beyond the document itself),
and no wiring. It is purely research and documentation.
Approval context: This is a DISCOVERY slice: research what each provider's API can actually
return, document it, and produce a feasibility matrix. No implementation yet.
The intake asks for "a view of how fast each plan is being consumed" driven
by provider-side queries. Before building that view, we need to know wh…
